beats.label: Salaam. This is Liam, in for Bear. Claude Code has an effort dial, and it's tempting to always turn
Three terms. Effort: how much compute Claude spends on a task. An edge case: an unusual input where
Here's the dial. Five settings: low, medium, high, x high, and max. Opus five point five starts at m
So what is effort, really? Thariq Shihipar, in his post Spending your effort, says it gives the mode
Think of it like a deadline. Given one hour, you'd bring the best version that meets the task, then
Effort works the same way. Claude always tries to do your task reasonably, but higher effort means m
The clearest case is HTML JS filter, a Terminal-Bench three point oh task: an HTML sanitizer that st
On x high, it passed five of five. The run he traced took about thirty-three minutes. It reviewed it
His rule of thumb. Low for quick responses while you're in the loop: brainstorming, sketching, easy
High where verification matters or there are edge cases, like fixing a bug. Max when you want Claude
And his loop for feature work. Have Claude interview you about the spec. Build it on low. Review it,
Your turn. Paste this into Claude Code: Plan one real task with me through the effort loop: name you
